settings.candidate_policy: IDs 1..embedding_rows-1 minus complete original training history
settings.tie_policy: ascending candidate ID, stable descending score
settings.position_policy: replace IDs in fixed slots; preserve padding and final query; shuffling controls reported separately

training_margins.distribution: 320 independent uniform eligible-user draws with replacement when eligible users exist; latest L teacher-forced transitions; negatives uniform over catalog minus full observed training history; independent user-selection and negative-sampling RNG streams

embedding_geometry.centering: subtract sampled column means for SVD only

unsupported_or_unavailable.lexical_arm: not run: neighborhood annotation and timestamp-matched controls are not established; no semantic claim
unsupported_or_unavailable.slot_preserving_arm: fixed-slot ID replacements implemented; explicit positional-ID/key-value interventions remain unavailable
unsupported_or_unavailable.fault_injection: not run: bounded-copy corruption/repair and model-specific fault hooks are not supplied
unsupported_or_unavailable.paired_validation_hr10: host-owned outcomes and candidate sets unavailable here; no validation surrogate computed
unsupported_or_unavailable.trial_ledger: host must log every inspected trial and add this call's diagnostic cost

metric_definitions.history_edits: Frozen-model sensitivity, not recommendation accuracy. Draws are averaged within user, then users equally. Five supplied users/category are exploratory, not representative. Aggregate four complete category reports externally with equal weights; never treat absent reports as zero.
metric_definitions.matched_history_edit_contrasts: Five predeclared draw seeds select older/recent nonfinal slots and one shared unseen donor meeting both popularity and predecessor-transition calipers. Require donor-to-displaced TF-IDF cosines to differ by at most 0.1 when both exist. No caliper relaxation. Separate final-slot matches. C excludes complete original history; C_minus additionally excludes all planned donors, with a fresh baseline. Recent-minus-older contrasts use only complete successful pairs. Average matched draws within user, then users equally; coverage and failures remain explicit. Donor rank change is edited minus baseline rank, so negative means promotion. Controls measure disagreement with SASRec, never accuracy. Externally average four complete category reports equally.
metric_definitions.top10_overlap: Intersection of original and edited top min(10,C), divided by min(10,C); higher is greater stability, not necessarily greater accuracy.
metric_definitions.top10_mean_absolute_rank_displacement: Mean absolute change in zero-based full-catalog rank over the original top min(10,C); stable descending score sorting breaks ties by ascending item ID.
metric_definitions.strict_pair_flip_rate: Fraction of a fixed deterministic sample of at most 4096 distinct unordered candidate pairs whose strict ordering reverses. Exclude pairs tied in either condition; report ties and denominator. Undefined denominators return null.
metric_definitions.raw_mean_absolute_score_change: Mean absolute paired logit change. Scale-dependent; cannot be compared as accuracy or interpreted as invariant sensitivity.
metric_definitions.feature_l2_change: L2 change in the encoder's final feature at position L-1, separately from score/rank effects; representation-scale-dependent.
metric_definitions.training_margins: Mean, lower empirical p10, P(negative>positive), and P(margin<0.5) under the stated independent training-only diagnostic distribution. Not directly comparable to live-loader margins; raw values depend on logit scale. Missing cases are null, not zero.
metric_definitions.embedding_geometry: At most 2048 nonpadding rows sampled with a local seed-42 generator. Mean cosine measures directional alignment only. Centered singular-value entropy gives effective rank, normalized by min(n-1,d); leading mass uses singular values, not squared energy. Neither proves collapse or user diversity.
metric_definitions.edit_policy: Primary paired replacements preserve sequence length, padding, positions and the final item. Divide nonfinal positions into contiguous halves, assigning any extra position to recent. Final-slot replacements are separate. Prefix shuffling and last-item-only inputs remain distribution-shifting complementary controls. No model retraining or benchmark input changes occur.
metric_definitions.exploratory_user_bootstrap_95_interval: 2000 locally seeded within-category user bootstrap replicates after averaging draws within user, conditional on recorded matches. Undefined with fewer than two users. Excludes rematching, training-seed variation and adaptive search. Leave-one-user-out summaries expose panel sensitivity; five users/category provide weak uncertainty estimates. Full-catalog stability differs from pinned sampled-candidate HR@10.
metric_definitions.selection_policy: The unchanged host-pinned four-category macro validation HR@10 is the sole selection metric. One changed hit among 200 users/category changes macro HR@10 by 0.00125. No test outcomes, ratings, reviews, item categories, prices, stores, or simulator traits are used.
metric_definitions.integrity: Identity, repeated inference, and positive score-rescaling checks are observations, not assumed passes. All module flags and Python/NumPy/torch RNG state are restored; live training iterator and worker state are untouched.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_cost: Synchronized wall seconds for this call, including CPU preparation. On CUDA the same duration is reported as allocated single-GPU seconds for conservative search-budget accounting; this is not measured kernel-active time.
